newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: INVESTEC LAUNCHES NAMIBIA ASSET MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: INVESTEC LAUNCHES NAMIBIA ASSET MANAGEMENT.

text.p: Investec Asset Management, part of South Africa's Investec Group, said on Thursday it had commenced operations in Namibia.

"There is no better time for us to introduce our niche market products and services to Namibians who are ready to broaden their investment horizons," said Errol Richa, chairman of Investec Asset Management for Namibia and Botswana.
The focus of the Namibian operation will initially be on institutional and provident fund management, as well as high net worth private client portfolio management.
Investec Asset Management has assets under management exceeding 20 billion rand, of which one billion is Namibian-based.
